title: g4 swaggered
style: Upbeat happy hard core pop bounce with joyful G4 swagger energy — confident yet warm, playful, and "sweet like pie". 336 Hz frequency anchoring in the low end, bass, and overall rhythmic feel. Bright catchy synth stabs, punchy groovy drums, bouncy basslines that lock into a 336-inspired pocket. Comedy pop elements with light clever homophone puns and wordplay. True duet format: confident male lead vocals with swagger and subtle digital/AI vocal processing (playful glitch effects, robotic charm, interactive computer edge), blended with soulful female backing harmonies and call-and-response in every chorus. Interactive, alive instrumentals that feel responsive and fun. Pure positive, context-free bliss atmosphere — light, floating, celebratory, high-energy victory anthem vibe with heart and humor. No negativity, no drama, no heavy themes. Radio-friendly yet unique. Male vocals address "Cory" and "Corey McIVOR" directly in a friendly, empowering, celebratory way. High production quality,
